title: A Combined Experimental and DFT Study of H2O Effect on In2O3/ZrO2 Catalysts for CO2 Hydrogenation to Methanol
extraction_notes: No SI figures in the provided Supporting Information show measured catalytic performance data (CO2 conversion, CH3OH/CO/CH4 selectivity, or methanol STY/formation rate). Therefore no plotted SI performance points were digitised.
